posts.title: Principles of Agent Factories
posts.description: Agent factories are a set of principles, not a platform. What it takes to run a fleet of AI agents reliably - orchestration, isolation, observability, human intervention points, and benchmarks built from real cases.

posts.title: Software is a Service
posts.description: AI made generating code cheap. The value moves to the people who keep software secure and running. SaaS becomes SiaS.

posts.title: Breaching Your Own Security Rules
posts.description: Coding agents manage their own permission files. That's a fundamental security architecture flaw, and the CVEs prove it.
